**Answer:** The change is the O3-6028 fix recorded in the changeset `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md`. It makes the login location picker use `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` as its page size and removes the unused `chooseLocation.numberToShow`. The line that passes the configured value to the picker is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, which sets `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}`.

The picker's own default of 50 is still in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`. It only applies when no value is passed, which is why it looked like the configured value was ignored.

I could not find the commit SHA that merged this change. The only evidence I found is the changeset file, so I have not confirmed it has landed on the default branch.

Evidence, best first:

1. `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md:5`: the O3-6028 changelog entry describing the fix.
2. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`: passes the configured value to `LocationPicker`.
3. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`: the picker's default of 50 when no value is passed.
4. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:42`: `useLocations` is called with `locationsPerRequest`, so it sets the request size.
5. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44-49`: defines `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` with default 50 and a must-be-positive validator.
6. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457`: tests that the configured value reaches the picker and that zero falls back to 1.
7. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/__mocks__/config.mock.ts:16`: mock config sets `locationsPerRequest: 50`.
8. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/__mocks__/config.mock.ts:10-12`: leftover `numberToShow: 3` alongside `locationsPerRequest: 50`, the stale property the fix removes.
